target: acceptance 7 — the payload check is a positive test for a marker, so installing the marker must make hardened resolve. Without this the whole suite passes with the check hardcoded to refuse.
cmd: mkdir -p a; printf "%s\n" "<!-- profile-hardened-payload: v1 -->" > a/reviewer.md; v=$(TRACKER_AGENTS_DIR="$PWD/a" "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/tracker.sh" profile "$FIXTURES/profile/hardened.md" 2>/dev/null); c=$?; v2=$(TRACKER_AGENTS_DIR="$PWD/empty_dir_xyz" "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/tracker.sh" profile "$FIXTURES/profile/hardened.md" 2>/dev/null); c2=$?; printf '{"withMarker":"%s","c":%s,"withoutMarker":"%s","c2":%s}' "$v" "$c" "$v2" "$c2"
